newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air September load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air September load factor down.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Tuesday its systemwide passenger load factor dropped 0.7 points to 71.5 percent from 72.2 percent.
Systemwide available set miles rose 8.5 percent to 8.04 billion from 7.40 billion and revenue passenger miles gained 7.5 percent to 5.75 billion from 5.35 billion.
Systemwide cargo ton miles for the month rose 0.5 percent to 190.7 million from 189.7 million.

Internationally, passenger load factor dropped 0.3 points in September to 82.2 percent from 82.5 percent. Revenue passenger miles rose 10.4 percent to 2.75 billion from 2.49 billion. Available seat miles rose 10.7 percent to 3.34 billion from 3.02 billion.

Domestically, passenger load factor dropped 1.2 points in September to 63.9 percent from 65.1 percent. Revenue passenger miles rose five percent to 3.0 billion from 2.86 billion. Available seat miles rose seven percent to 4.70 billion from 4.39 billion.
